name: quote-lifecycle-bellman-single-leg-screen
mechanism: At a review boundary choose KEEP, REPLACE, or CANCEL by a one-step Bellman action value with a no-fill continuation term.
null: Continuation-aware cancel/replace has no incremental fee-net value over always replacing at the same passive distance.
existing_baseline: Always replace the passive quote every selected 15-minute window.
single_integration_point: One lifecycle action scalar before cancel/replace; no price or quantity control.
update_order: predict, store quote markout label, mature, then update distance-bucket posterior
executable_outcome: one-fill terminal markout using future executable bid; public BBO touch is only a fill proxy
fees: 10 bps maker fee plus 2 bps adverse-selection allowance for the one-sided screen
reason: The apparent gain is cancellation of almost every isolated fee-negative leg, not evidence for a completed two-leg continuation policy. A pair-cycle/post-fill continuation replay is required before integration.
